descriptions.description: Lectotype (Stace & Jarvis in Bot. J. Linn. Soc. 91: 441. 1985): Alstroemer 20, Herb. Linn. No. 104.11 (LINN).
" Habitat in Galliae & Angliae maritimis. " RCN: 727.

Note: Meikle (El. Cyprus 2: 1724. 23 Apr 1985) indicated unspecified material in LINN as type but did not distinguish between sheets 104.11, 104.12 and 104.13 (which are not part of a single gathering so Art. 9.15 does not apply). Stace & Jarvis' typification (in Bot. J. Linn. Soc. 91: 441. 11 Dec 1985) is more detailed than that of Stace (in Davis, Fl. Turkey 9: 468. Dec 1985), published in the same month but with the precise date unknown.
